name: grand_totals_comparable_and_new_branch
purpose: Summarize like-for-like performance and separate the new branch contribution from total current revenue.
intent: Return one row with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], a derived prior transactions value as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] filtered to the like-for-like branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 using TREATAS on all four branch columns: 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. Also return separate one-row totals for current-only CFH022 using the same measures where prior-period percentages are not used as a growth basis. No grouping, one row per population.
dax:
EVALUATE
UNION(
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ROW(
            "Population", "Like-for-like",
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "net bills PAST derived", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
        )
    ),
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ROW(
            "Population", "CFH022",
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", BLANK(),
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", BLANK(),
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "net bills PAST derived", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", BLANK(),
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH022" },
            'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH022" },
            'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH022" },
            'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH022" },
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
        )
    )
)

name: latest_month_store_scorecard
purpose: Show the most recent month by branch so the summary can lead with current branch performance.
intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month], filtered to the like-for-like branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], then restrict to the single latest available month value from 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]. Return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,

        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(

            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "prior transactions", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),

    ),
    [net revenue CURRENT], DESC
)

name: category_decline_and_revenue_share
purpose: Measure how many categories are declining and how much revenue those categories represent.
intent: Return one row from 'CAT_TABLE' using the model measures [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT %], [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past], filtered to the like-for-like branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 using TREATAS on all four branch columns: 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. No grouping, one row.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "COUNT", [COUNT],
        "COUNT_TOTAL", [COUNT_TOTAL],
        "COUNT %", [COUNT %],
        "sum deg cur rev", [sum deg cur rev],
        "sum deg past rev", [sum deg past rev],
        "sum total cur rev", [sum total cur rev],
        "sum total past rev", [sum total past rev],
        "contribution cur", [contribution cur],
        "contribution past", [contribution past]
    ),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
)

name: latest_true_transactions_by_branch
purpose: Add the current true shopping-trip view from the daily table for recent branch context, without using it for year-on-year comparison.
intent: From 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt', first identify the latest date with nonblank values in 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]. Then group by 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE] for that date and compute true branch transactions as SUMX over VALUES('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]) of CALCULATE(MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS])) within each branch-date context, so repeated rows do not overcount. Return one row per branch for the comparable branch codes CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021. Sort by the computed true transaction total DESC, row limit 15.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestDateWithBills =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            VALUES('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
            CALCULATE(MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS])) <> BLANK()
        ),
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE],
        TREATAS({ LatestDateWithBills }, 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
        TREATAS({ "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE]),
        "True Branch Transactions",
            SUMX(
                VALUES('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
                CALCULATE(MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]))
            )
    ),
    [True Branch Transactions], DESC
)
